admission.justification: Named presence and raw equality prevent a parity normalizer from hiding producer regressions while comparing the pre-count baseline.

applicability: The source-bound closeout parity fixture compares the preserved before world with the two current worlds in leaf_preview and leaf_apply.
conditions: Before removing any named counts, both current answers are asserted to contain refreshedCount, unchangedCount and staleCount.
Raw grant/current equality after the preexisting volatility scrub is asserted before take-out.
Only those three route_index_refresh keys are removed, only in the named leaf phases and only from current worlds; the before world and series phases are untouched by this repair.
exclusions: No product response alteration or generic metadata/answer-key suppression.
Prior L46 conversion and L113 seat-field normalization remain separately attributed, not new rule12 changes.
statement: In the leaf phases of the closeout parity test (`leaf_preview`, `leaf_apply`) the comparison of the world of before with the current worlds takes the three counts of `route_index_refresh` (`refreshedCount`, `unchangedCount`, `staleCount`, demanded by MIK-R110 rule 5) out of the current answers by their names, and only after both current answers are shown to hold all three; the world of before stays as it is, and the equality of the grant world and the current world is asserted before any take-out. The product's answer is not changed.
